g.title: WorkerRuntime → WorkerExecutor: 创建并注入 Client
WorkerRuntime → WorkerSession: 创建一个共享实例
WorkerClient → WorkerProtocolError: 协议或恢复不匹配时抛出
WorkerClient → FlowToolCaller: 结构化满足 / tool_caller=self
WorkerExecutor → FlowToolCaller: execute() 的临时入参
WorkerExecutor → WorkerMCP: 仅 INITIAL 的 async with
WorkerExecutor → VcsVerificationError: 抛出 / 捕获 → 失败结果
WorkerSession → SessionError: 证据无效时抛出
RepositoryWorkspaces → WorkspaceSlot: 创建 / 更新槽位
RepositoryWorkspaces → VcsVerificationError: 抛出 / 捕获
AmpCodingAgent → run_amp(): 执行编码 CLI
AmpHistory → run_amp(): 执行只读 thread export
run_amp() → _OutputLimit: read() 抛出 / 外层捕获
update_worker() → InstalledPackage: 经 installed_package() 读取
update_worker() → UpdateError: 抛出 / 捕获
